title: Bihar BPSC Prosecution Officer APO Exam Date 2026 Out for 300 Post
intro: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has Officially Released Exam Date for the Post of Prosecution Officers (APO) under Home Department (Prosecution Directorate), Govt. of Bihar, Recruitment 2026 for 300 Post. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to this Jobs. Exam Held on July 15, 2026 & Admit Card Released On July, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Exam Date Notice Now in The Given Link Below.
importantDates: Online Apply Start On : 27 February 2026
Registration Last Date : 20 March 2026
Fee Payment Last Date : 20 March 2026
Admit Card Available: July 2026
Exam Date :  15 July 2026
All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
Payment Mode: Pay Exam Fee Through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode.
Note: Candidates who do not provide their Aadhaar number as an identity proof in the online application will have to pay an additional Biometric fee of Rs.200/-
Minimum Age :  21 Years
Maximum Age : 37 Years (Male)
Maximum Age : 40 Years (Female UR, BC/ EBC-Male & Female)
Maximum Age : 42 Years (SC/ ST-Male & Female)
For Age Relaxation.Read the Official Notification
